notes.title: Patch v109 (October 20)
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Critical bug fix that was causing enemies to stop spawning.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v108 (October 14)
notes.content:
- Fixed some unintended exploits.
- Fixed bug related to massive exp gains at the extreme late-game.
- Performance improvements.

notes.title: Long Awaited Performance Patch and Bug Fixes (Feb 23, 2022)
notes.content:
[b]Miscellaneous:[/b]
[list]
[*] Capped framerate on PC to 60 fps to improve performance (Steam/Kong).
[*] Added the new mandatory App Tracking Privacy prompt for iOS 14+ devices (iOS).
[*] Improved rewarded video ads experience.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where some players couldn't claim their PvP Tournament rewards (iOS/Kong).
[*] Fixed issue where the game would randomly crash (iOS).
[*] Fixed some unintended exploits.
[*] Fixed bug related to massive exp gains at the extreme late-game.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.44 (New Leaderboard Titles and Bug Fixes)
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*]- New achievement for consecutive waves passed.
[*]- New leaderboard titles for consecutive waves passed and spell upgrade levels.
[*]- Added enemies killed and highest gold drop to the current run metrics menu.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]- Challenge Map points rewards now scale a bit quicker at higher waves, encouraging you to push further (more info on Discord).
[*]- Cargo and Tech HP reduction upgrades in the gem store now cap at level 100.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]- Fixed bug where the Tournament leaderboards sometimes would not load, preventing you from claiming your rewards.
[*]- Fixed bug where Cargo Ships would sometimes spawn with 0 HP and be unkillable.
[/list]

notes.title: Challenge Map Rewards / Customizable Leaderboard Displays (Update v1.43)
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Challenge Map rewards - earn a new resource by playing this minigame, and spend them on a whole new set of upgrades!
[*] Customizable leaderboard icons and titles - show some flair by unlocking new icons and titles via upgrades and challenges.
[*] Significantly improved the Farm/Push map perks, and added mini-perks to all the normal maps.
[*] Prestiged achievements - continue completing achievements for huge 50 gem rewards, even after completing all 12 stars. 
[*] New achievements for Challenge Map, Leaderboard Icons, and Helicopter Bonuses. 
[*] New "Reduce Tech Ship HP gem upgrade".
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the achievement requirements for some that were very unreasonable.
[*] Improved the "Reduce Cargo Ship HP" gem upgrade by reducing its cost and increasing its effect.
[*] Improved the "Gold Drop" gem upgrade to give +2 per level.
[/list]

notes.title: Challenge Map Minigame! (Update v1.40)
notes.content:
All monster upgrades are turned off. 
All monsters have roughly the same base damage.
A new map with two enemy spawn locations.
Monster placement, strategy, and timing are key. 
[b]Fight for the highest position on the new "Challenge Map" leaderboar[/b]d!

notes.title: Update v1.38
notes.content:
- 24 Steam Achievements to complete.
- Now able to change your in-game display name on the leaderboards.
- Improved anti-cheat measures.
- Minor bug fixes and UI improvements.
